card.summary: 1A Low Dropout regulator, positive, 3.3V fixed output, SOT-223
600mA low dropout linear regulator, with enable pin, 3.8V-6V input voltage range, 3.3V fixed positive output, SOT-23-5
Positive 1.5A 35V Linear Regulator, Fixed Output 5V, TO-220/TO-263/TO-252
250mA Low Quiscent Current LDO, 3.3V output, SOT-23
DCDC-Converter, RECOM, RECOM_R-78E-0.5, SIP-3, pitch 2.54mm, package size 11.6x8.5x10.4mm^3, https://www.recom-power.com/pdf/Innoline/R-78Exx-0.5.pdf
Single Output LDO, 200 mA, Fixed 3.3 V Output, 2 to 5.5 V Input, with Low IQ, 5-pin SOT (DDC), -40 to 125 degC, Green (RoHS no SbBr)

decision.reason: A pocket metronome runs from a small battery and needs a 3.3V rail with very low quiescent current, so a small LDO fits best. The MCP1700-3.3 has ultra-low Iq (~1.6uA), 250mA output for a small speaker driver and MCU, and a wide input range
